card.line: The Way of Holiness is a highway promised in Isaiah where the redeemed of the LORD will walk safely and return to Zion with joy.

moments.title: A highway for the redeemed
moments.text: Isaiah says there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it, and fools will not stray onto it, but only those who walk in the Way.

moments.title: Return to Zion with singing
moments.text: The redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing. They will be crowned with everlasting joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
